entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: ...Without a strong belief, the eloquence[n]used to draw people in will be nothing[n]but poison.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: Even though we've known this since[n]ancient times, people never really learn.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: Now, Martin Luther King Jr. is a man[n]who expressed his beliefs. What were[n]his famous words?
This question will affect Yoshida's trust[n]in me. I have to answer it correctly!
entries.uk: Від цієї відповіді залежить довіра Йошіди[n]до мене. Треба відповісти правильно!

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: Yes, it's a line from a speech that brought[n]racial equality and ended discrimination.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: Looks like you have a dream as well.[n]Never give up your dream of becoming[n]a politician.
I was somehow able to maintain[n]his trust!

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: ...Martin Luther King Jr. said, [n]"I have a dream."

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: Is your dream of becoming a politician[n]real? I'm starting to have my doubts.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: That is all for today. Go home.
Yoshida is starting to lose his trust[n]in me...
